title: Outdoor Grilled Venezuelan Ground Beef Empanadas
description: A sour and chewy Venezuelan dish featuring ground beef and soffritto base, perfect for brunch, made with a binchotan grill and nut free friendly ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the binchotan grill to medium high heat.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and cook the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the ground beef to the skillet and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the diced tomato to the skillet and cook until the mixture is heated through.
Season the mixture with salt, black pepper, and lime juice.
Roll out the empanada dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Spoon a small amount of the beef mixture onto the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough in half over the filling and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with olive oil and place them on the preheated grill.
Cook the empanadas for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown and crispy.
